scope: Real PoE Steam/DWProton on River/XWayland. Manual user input only; no forced game activation or game commands. Debug candidate, before final package verification.

regression.symptom: After closing from outside, clicks inside the reopened panel could close it again.
regression.observed: Focus-in on main window followed by a button event dispatched to the right backdrop, with coordinates belonging to the main panel.
regression.cause: The backdrop was hidden on button press before release completed, leaving GDK device-grab routing attached to the hidden surface.
regression.private_reproduction: Same virtual pointer kept alive across all clicks, with 80 ms between press and release. Immutable 0.24 package fails this sequence; release-based 0.25 passes.
regression.fix: Arm only an outside press, then close after the matching release finishes dispatching; cancel a pending close when the panel generation changes.
regression.confirmed_sequence: Open Ctrl+Alt+D, close outside, reopen, click base chip; repeat twice.

screenshots: The two final review images use a private compositor and synthetic Trade offers. No live price claim.
